what: The 45 planted statements of the prime-gap 186 statement layer as they were checked on 2026-11-10 (cert-machine's six records, corpus/prime-gaps-186/intake/; the audit's page https://carlostoledo.co/reports/prime-gaps-186.html, its note doi:10.5281/zenodo.24122214). Each record names its spec by sha256 and gives every planted statement's outcome, not its text; the texts are copied here from those six specs, which stayed in the audit's working folder. Three specs were written by claimbox and completed by a bridge script (the identity-mode fields; for dhl, F3's proof); three were written by hand, because the writer could not plant inside an axiom or a definition. The reference the writer is measured against (python3 -m claimbox intake calibrate pg186): which of these statements it now writes alone. Statements of OpenAI's Challenge.lean, Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-PrimeGaps186 in each target's folder).

f3.tactic:
intro h
  refine h (_root_.PrimeGap186.admissibleTuple.map ⟨((↑) : ℕ → ℤ), Nat.cast_injective⟩)
    (by rw [Finset.card_map]; exact _root_.PrimeGap186.admissibleTuple_card) ?_
  intro p hp
  haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hnot⟩ := _root_.PrimeGap186.admissibleTuple_admissible p hp
  refine ⟨(a : ZMod p), ?_⟩
  intro z hz heq
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz
  apply hnot
  refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
  have h2 : (n : ZMod p) = (a : ZMod p) := by simpa using heq
  have h3 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' n a p).mp h2
  rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp ha)] at h3

∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (A B : ZMod p),
    A ≠ 0 → B ≠ 0 →
      ‖∑ t : ZMod p, if t ≠ 0 ∧ t ≠ -1 then
        PrimeGap186.unnormalizedKloosterman2 p (A / t) *
          PrimeGap186.unnormalizedKloosterman2 p (B / (t + 1)) else 0‖ ≤
        8 * (p : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (p : ℝ)
